map.标准分 Z 值计算器：输入原始值、均值与标准差，求标准分 Z = (x−μ)/σ: Standard-score (Z-score) calculator: enter the raw value, mean, and standard deviation to compute Z = (x−μ)/σ, used for data normalization and outlier detection.
map.标准分把原始值 x 减去均值 μ 再除以标准差 σ，得到相对均值的标准差数。z: The standard score subtracts the mean μ from the raw value x and divides by the standard deviation σ, giving the number of standard deviations from the mean. z > 0 is above the mean, z < 0 below; it is commonly used for data normalization and outlier detection (e.g. |z| > 2 or 3 is treated as anomalous).
: x=190 cm, μ=170, σ=10: z=2.0, 2σ above the mean (about 97.7% below).
